# Welcome

Hello! I am Ziyang Tian, a graduate student studying biostatistics at
Columbia University. This website introduces my academic background and
shares work from my data science coursework.

# Explore this website

- My [resume](resume.html) describes my education and relevant experience.
- My [Instacart dashboard](dashboard.html) explores grocery shopping
  patterns through three interactive visualizations.
- My [GitHub profile](https://github.com/ziyang-tian) contains my public
  code repositories.

The dashboard was developed for P8105 and uses the Instacart dataset
distributed with the `p8105.datasets` R package.
